goals: Mechanistic: characterize how runoff is partitioned (surface overland flow vs subsurface drainage) and timed (rain vs snowmelt) across the Naches elevation and soil gradient
Validation: compare simulated runoff generation to USGS stream gauges (contingent on an aggregation/routing capability)

model_choice.rationale: Single-column ELM simulates the water partitioning and snow physics that generate runoff at a point; NLDAS forcing resolves the elevation-driven rain/snow gradient that dominates Cascades runoff. Spatial sampling spans the basin's heterogeneity.

answerable: Point-scale runoff generation and partitioning (surface runoff vs subsurface drainage) per column
Snowmelt timing and its control on runoff, across the elevation transect (NLDAS resolves ~a dozen precip/temperature levels over this relief)
Soil-texture control on the infiltration/runoff split via SSURGO

not_answerable.aspect: Validation of runoff against USGS stream gauges
not_answerable.why: Single-column ELM has no lateral routing; independent 1-D columns produce no integrated streamflow at a gauge
not_answerable.needs: runoff aggregation / stream routing to convert per-column runoff into gauge-comparable discharge

not_answerable.aspect: Sub-12 km orographic detail in runoff generation
not_answerable.why: NLDAS forcing is ~12 km with no within-cell lapse rate; fine terrain contrasts are unresolved

sampling_strategy.approach: stratified transect (elevation bands x dominant soil), anchored on user-selected columns
sampling_strategy.n_justification: Three user columns plus three augmentation columns give at least one column per elevation band with a coarse-vs-fine soil contrast; this is the smallest set that spans the rain-snow gradient and the soil split controlling the runoff partition without a blind grid.
sampling_strategy.placement_logic: Concentrate on the rain-snow transition band (mid elevation) where snowmelt timing and thus runoff generation are most sensitive; keep low-elevation valley and high-elevation snow endpoints as bounding cases.
sampling_strategy.replication: None beyond one column per stratum; light and endpoint-focused given the strategy-level scope.

sampling_plan.reason: User-pinned low-elevation eastern point; retained as requested but lies outside the HUC bbox eastern edge (see open_questions) — treated as a low-elevation margin case.
User-pinned column in the western/mid basin; anchors the rain-snow transition where snowmelt-driven runoff is most sensitive.
User-pinned northern column; anchors a mid-to-upper elevation runoff-generation case.
Fills the snow-dominated band to capture peak-SWE-driven melt runoff timing at the upper end of the relief.
In-domain low-elevation column on coarse soil to isolate the infiltration-dominated (high-drainage, low-overland) end of the partition.
Same rain-snow band as user column B but on fine soil to isolate the soil-texture control on surface-runoff vs drainage independent of climate.

validation_design.comparison: aggregated — per-column QOVER+QDRAI would need to be routed/aggregated to the gauge's contributing area before comparison; NOT possible with current single-column stack
validation_design.metric: bias / NSE on monthly hydrograph (once routing exists)
validation_design.n_validation_points: unknown — depends on number of in-domain USGS gauges and routing capability

validation_design.target_variable: snowmelt timing / peak SWE (supporting, process check)
validation_design.comparison: analog / not requested — flagged as a gap; no SNOTEL listed in the brief

experiment_summary.primary_treatment: NLDAS-2 baseline forcing, native SSURGO soil, WTD-informed warm start

requires_capabilities.why: single columns produce no integrated discharge
NLDAS 12 km cells miss within-cell orographic gradients
requires_capabilities.blocks: fine-scale elevation control on runoff generation

requires_capabilities.why: subsurface drainage and water table are slow states that cold-start as artifacts
soil texture is a primary driver of the infiltration/runoff split
would let snowmelt timing be validated as a process check
requires_capabilities.blocks: independent confirmation of the snow-driven runoff mechanism
